method: Local image visual inspection; no application requests during maintenance
remediation: Initial key issuance screenshot mask was misplaced. The key was already revoked. That screenshot was overwritten by the safe revoked-state image. The final helper dismisses one-time values before captures.
duplicate_image_note: own-key-issued-masked.png is a safe duplicate of own-key-revoked.png, not evidence of the issuance screen.
limits: Visual inspection does not replace the separate textual artifact sentinel scan or live revoked-key rejection check.
